name: WWT Washington Adventure Play Area
description: Nature-based adventure play area with timber trails, rope bridges, climbing frames and a giant slide, plus an Archimedes' screw water pump, a splash zone, a nature kitchen and sand play. Not gated, so children need watching. Open 10am to 5.30pm.
fee: Non-members pay to visit; see the centre's tickets page for prices. WWT members get in free at all 10 wetland centres.
